description: This file implements category management functions for the focalboard server, including creating, updating, deleting, reordering categories, and moving boards to default categories.

classes.name: App
classes.description: Main application struct providing category management methods.

methods.name: GetCategory
methods.description: Retrieves a category by its ID.

methods.name: CreateCategory
methods.description: Creates a new category after validation and broadcasts the change.

methods.name: UpdateCategory
methods.description: Updates an existing category with validation, permission checks, and broadcasts the change.

methods.name: DeleteCategory
methods.description: Deletes a category after permission checks and moves associated boards to default category.

methods.name: moveBoardsToDefaultCategory
methods.description: Moves boards from a specified category to the user's default category.

methods.name: ReorderCategories
methods.description: Reorders categories based on a new order and broadcasts the change.

methods.name: verifyNewCategoriesMatchExisting
methods.description: Verifies that the new category order matches existing categories.
